add_generic_rpn_outputs: add RPN outputs for objectness classification and bounding box regression to a Detectron model with FPN support
add_single_scale_rpn_outputs: add RPN outputs including conv layers and proposal generation to a single scale Detectron model without FPN
add_single_scale_rpn_losses: add classification and bounding box regression losses to a single scale RPN model using SigmoidCrossEntropy and SmoothL1
review_add_generic_rpn_outputs: review the add_generic_rpn_outputs function to understand how it delegates between FPN and single scale RPN paths
refactor_add_single_scale_rpn_outputs: refactor add_single_scale_rpn_outputs to customize anchor generation or convolution layer initialization parameters
